from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashReport(BaseModel):
    """A single extraction of cash and cash equivalents data from one financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company that filed the document")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact text label of the line item in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash line item")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the reporting period ends")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_reports: list[CashReport]
